source_title: Laws of the Game 2026/27 (English, single pages)
reviewed_statement: Law 7.1 establishes the standard scheduled 90 regulation minutes (2 x 45), excluding interval, extra time and shoot-outs. Reduction requires prior referee/team agreement and competition-rule permission. Added time and penalty completion can extend play; abandonment can prevent completion. This is not a guarantee of any individual match duration. No historical or next-season validity asserted.
